end_of_travel: {{axis}} is at the end of its travel.

toolhead.title: Toolhead
toolhead.z_note: Z+ moves the bed down, away from the nozzle, and Z− moves it up. Z moves are at most {{max}} mm.
toolhead.locked_printing: Moving the toolhead is locked while printing. Pause to move it.
toolhead.home_first: Home an axis before moving it.
toolhead.position_note: Enter a position and press Enter to move there. The small numbers are where the toolhead is right now.

extruder.title: Extruder
extruder.too_cold: Extruder disabled, below min_extrude_temp ({{min}} °C). The nozzle is {{temp}} °C.
extruder.detail_setup: The extruder is set for {{fil}} mm filament and a {{noz}} mm nozzle.
extruder.detail_flow: Extruding at {{speed}} mm/s, the extruder should give about {{flow}} mm³/s.
extruder.detail_length: Extruding {{length}} mm of filament at {{factor}}% flow gives about {{extruded}} mm of extrusion.
extruder.detail_speed: At a {{layer}} mm layer height, the fastest it could print is about {{speed}} mm/s.

z_offset.title: Z offset
z_offset.save_config_body: SAVE_CONFIG writes the saved changes to printer.cfg and restarts Klipper.
z_offset.note_probe: The offset applies until Klipper restarts. Save moves it into the probe offset, which SAVE_CONFIG then keeps.
z_offset.note_endstop: The offset applies until Klipper restarts. Save moves it into the endstop offset, which SAVE_CONFIG then keeps.

limits.note: These last until Klipper restarts, and macros or the slicer’s G-code can change them during a print. Each is capped at its configured value.

temps.no_presets: No presets yet. Add them in Settings.
temps.cool_down_body: The printer is busy. Turning off the heaters may result in a failed print.
temps.heaters_note: Targets stay within each heater’s limits. A Box heater is limited by the filament loaded in that Box.
temps.box_locked: The filament loaded in this Box can’t be heated.
temps.breakpoints_error: Enter a number above 0, or leave it empty.
temps.calibrate_note: Runs {{command}}, which heats the {{name}} and takes a few minutes. Use a target close to what you print at. SAVE_CONFIG keeps the result and restarts Klipper.

heaters.locked: This heater can’t be turned on with the filament loaded.

outputs.fans_note: Klipper runs the hotend, board, and chamber heater fans by itself. Macros and the chamber guard can change the others again.

macros.all_hidden: Every macro is hidden. Use Organize to show some.
macros.name: Name
